dialogues.jp:
――とは言え、６年ぶりに再会したっていうの
に逃げ回っていても可哀相だよな……。
dialogues.en:
Well, it would be pathetic to try to avoid her when we've
just been reunited after six years.
dialogues.text:
Well, it would be pathetic to try to avoid her when we've
just been reunited after six years.

dialogues.jp: 「……別に何かあるわけじゃないんだ」
dialogues.en: "I don't think anything bad will happen."
dialogues.text: "I don't think anything bad will happen."

dialogues.jp:
もう、あの頃と違って、さくらだって精神的に
成長している｛・・／はず｝だ。
dialogues.en: I'm sure Sakura has matured emotionally. I hope.
dialogues.text: I'm sure Sakura has matured emotionally. I hope.

dialogues.jp:
意味もなく叩いてきたり、わけも分からず怒鳴っ
たりすることもない｛・・／はず｝。
dialogues.en:
I don't think she's likely to hit me without reason, or
shout without understanding.
dialogues.text:
I don't think she's likely to hit me without reason, or
shout without understanding.

dialogues.jp:
「さっきは久しぶりの再会で、ちょっと慌てて
　いただけさ」
dialogues.en:
"I know I lost my cool a little bit when I was reunited with
her out of the blue."
dialogues.text:
"I know I lost my cool a little bit when I was reunited with
her out of the blue."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく窓の外に目を向けながら、｛さわ／爽｝やかな
笑顔を浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Looking out the window for no reason, I smile.
dialogues.text: Looking out the window for no reason, I smile.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なに企んでるの朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "What are you up to, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What are you up to, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp:
通り抜けざまに、俺の顔を見て眞子が顔をしか
めていた。
dialogues.en: Mako makes a face at me as she passes me.
dialogues.text: Mako makes a face at me as she passes me.

dialogues.jp:
と、しばらくして、廊下に続く扉の影にピョコ
ピョコと耳のような物が見え出した。
dialogues.en:
After a while, I spot an object like an ear peeking in and
out from behind the door.
dialogues.text:
After a while, I spot an object like an ear peeking in and
out from behind the door.

dialogues.jp:
それはその場で揺れながら、何度か決心するよ
うに動くのだが、すぐに引っ込んでしまう。
dialogues.en:
It tries to come out, swings around, and then goes back
quickly again.
dialogues.text:
It tries to come out, swings around, and then goes back
quickly again.

dialogues.jp: 「なにやってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ！？」
dialogues.en: "Waa!"
dialogues.text: "Waa!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おっと」
dialogues.en: "Oops!"
dialogues.text: "Oops!"

dialogues.jp:
驚いて倒れそうになるさくらを、慌てて引き起
こす。
dialogues.en: She starts to fall over in surprise, so I catch her.
dialogues.text: She starts to fall over in surprise, so I catch her.

dialogues.jp: 腕にかかった体重は、本当に子供みたいに軽い。
dialogues.en: The weight in my arms really feels as light as a child.
dialogues.text: The weight in my arms really feels as light as a child.

dialogues.jp:
「あっ悪りぃ。引っ張っちゃったけど、腕とか
　痛くないか？」
dialogues.en: "Oops, I pulled your arms. Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Oops, I pulled your arms. Are you okay?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか足元が落ち着いてなさそうで、しっか
り立たせて顔を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
She looks wobbly, so I let her stand up first, watching her
face.
dialogues.text:
She looks wobbly, so I let her stand up first, watching her
face.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……あははは、やっぱりお兄ちゃんだっ。や
　さしい♪」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha.....You're my oniichan. You're so nice."
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha.....You're my oniichan. You're so nice."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ば、馬鹿かお前！」
dialogues.en: "Don't be silly!"
dialogues.text: "Don't be silly!"

dialogues.jp:
こっ恥ずかしいことを平然と言われて、こっち
の頬が熱くなる。
dialogues.en: My cheeks flush when I hear her bold remark.
dialogues.text: My cheeks flush when I hear her bold remark.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ……う〜んとね、ご飯食べない？」
dialogues.en: "Teehee... Would you like to eat something now?"
dialogues.text: "Teehee... Would you like to eat something now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「昼休みってのは昼飯を食べるもんだ」
dialogues.en: "At lunchtime, everybody's supposed to eat lunch."
dialogues.text: "At lunchtime, everybody's supposed to eat lunch."

dialogues.jp: ぶっきらぼうに言って教室に引き返す。
dialogues.en: I go back to the classroom with this blunt reply.
dialogues.text: I go back to the classroom with this blunt reply.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「失礼しま〜す」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me~."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me~."

dialogues.jp:
後ろからついてくる気配に、なぜか、懐かしさ
がこみ上げてくる。
dialogues.en: I'm struck by a sense of nostalgia when she follows me.
dialogues.text: I'm struck by a sense of nostalgia when she follows me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は自分の前の席が空いていることを確かめて
その椅子の向きをひっくり返した。
dialogues.en:
After I make sure the seat in front of me's empty, I turn it
around toward me.
dialogues.text:
After I make sure the seat in front of me's empty, I turn it
around toward me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「サンクス」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「普通だからいいって。別に感謝するほどのこ
　とじゃない」
dialogues.en: "I usually do this, so there's nothing to thank me for."
dialogues.text: "I usually do this, so there's nothing to thank me for."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……あはは。お兄ちゃん変わってない。ずっ
　とそのままでいてくれたんだね」
dialogues.en:
"Haha. You're still the same. Thank God, you haven't changed
at all."
dialogues.text:
"Haha. You're still the same. Thank God, you haven't changed
at all."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにが？」
dialogues.en: "What about?"
dialogues.text: "What about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なにか見返りを求めてやってるんじゃないん
　だよね」
dialogues.en:
"But you're not doing this in exchange for something, are
you?"
dialogues.text:
"But you're not doing this in exchange for something, are
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「世間一般的に普通だ」
dialogues.en: "Generally, it's a normal thing to do."
dialogues.text: "Generally, it's a normal thing to do."

dialogues.jp: 頬杖をついてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I give a sigh, resting my cheek on my hand.
dialogues.text: I give a sigh, resting my cheek on my hand.

dialogues.jp:
なんでこう、こいつは俺を持ち上げたがるのだ
ろう。
dialogues.en: Why does she want to overinterpret my actions like this?
dialogues.text: Why does she want to overinterpret my actions like this?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、音夢ちゃんは？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, where's Nemu-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, where's Nemu-chan?"

dialogues.jp:
椅子につく前に教室を見回して、さくらが首を
メトロノームのように傾ける。
dialogues.en:
Before sitting down, Sakura looks around the classroom and
tilts her head like a metronome.
dialogues.text:
Before sitting down, Sakura looks around the classroom and
tilts her head like a metronome.

dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、いつもは教室なんだけど、今日は珍し
　く食堂かどっかに行ったぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, she usually eats in the classroom, but she must be at
the dining hall for a change today."
dialogues.text:
"Well, she usually eats in the classroom, but she must be at
the dining hall for a change today."

dialogues.jp:
クラスメイトの視線を無視して、俺は自分の席
についてため息をついた。
dialogues.en:
I sigh and sit down, ignoring the curious eyes of my
classmates.
dialogues.text:
I sigh and sit down, ignoring the curious eyes of my
classmates.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……そうなんだ。まっ、いっか。ところでお
　兄ちゃんのご飯は？」
dialogues.en: "I see. Oh, well. What did you bring today, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "I see. Oh, well. What did you bring today, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp:
片手におさまるような小さなお弁当箱を広げて
さくらが今度は反対方向に首をかしげる。
dialogues.en:
Opening the little lunch box in her hand, Sakura tilts her
head the other way this time.
dialogues.text:
Opening the little lunch box in her hand, Sakura tilts her
head the other way this time.

dialogues.jp: 「ダイエット中」
dialogues.en: "I'm on a diet."
dialogues.text: "I'm on a diet."

dialogues.jp:
弁当を持参していない俺では、購買か食堂に行
く時間がなかったのだから仕方ない。
dialogues.en:
What can I do with no lunch box and no time to go to the
dining hall or the shop?
dialogues.text:
What can I do with no lunch box and no time to go to the
dining hall or the shop?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……これ食べる？」
dialogues.en: "Okay then... Do you want to eat some of these?"
dialogues.text: "Okay then... Do you want to eat some of these?"

dialogues.jp:
これ、と傾けられた弁当箱には、そぼろご飯や
卵焼きとか、うさぎの形に切られたリンゴがは
いっていた。
dialogues.en:
The lunchbox she shows me has rice with scrambled eggs,
fried egg and bunny-shaped apple pieces.
dialogues.text:
The lunchbox she shows me has rice with scrambled eggs,
fried egg and bunny-shaped apple pieces.

dialogues.jp: 「いいよ。そんな量じゃ俺が食ったら一口だ」
dialogues.en: "It's okay. I could eat all that with one bite."
dialogues.text: "It's okay. I could eat all that with one bite."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん……じゃあ、これ全部食べて――」
dialogues.en: "Oh come on... then, you can eat all of them."
dialogues.text: "Oh come on... then, you can eat all of them."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いいからお前が食え！」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about me! You should eat."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about me! You should eat."

dialogues.jp: 頭を押さえて、弁当箱に顔を近づけさせる。
dialogues.en:
I press her head down to bring her face close to her
lunchbox.
dialogues.text:
I press her head down to bring her face close to her
lunchbox.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あややややや！」
dialogues.en: "Ow, ow, ow!"
dialogues.text: "Ow, ow, ow!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まったく、なんでも食って早く大きくなれよ」
dialogues.en:
"Damn! You've got to get bigger by eating everything you
can."
dialogues.text:
"Damn! You've got to get bigger by eating everything you
can."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ご飯はちゃんと食べてるもん……いいじゃん
　背が低くったって」
dialogues.en:
"I do eat everything, though. What's wrong with being
short?"
dialogues.text:
"I do eat everything, though. What's wrong with being
short?"

dialogues.jp: あ。
dialogues.en: Oh.
dialogues.text: Oh.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、子供の頃から背の低さを気にして
たよなコイツ……。
dialogues.en:
Now I remember, she's been self-conscious about her height
since she was little.
dialogues.text:
Now I remember, she's been self-conscious about her height
since she was little.

dialogues.jp: 「悪い」
dialogues.en: "Sorry."
dialogues.text: "Sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「？　なにが？」
dialogues.en: "? What?"
dialogues.text: "? What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや……いいんだ」
dialogues.en: "Well, nothing."
dialogues.text: "Well, nothing."

dialogues.jp:
なぜだか笑いがこみあげてきて、俺は目を閉じ
て首をふった。
dialogues.en:
I feel like laughing all of a sudden, but instead, I shake
my head and close my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I feel like laughing all of a sudden, but instead, I shake
my head and close my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「早く食えよ」
dialogues.en: "Go ahead and eat!"
dialogues.text: "Go ahead and eat!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと不慣れな感じの箸を手に、美味しそう
にご飯を口に運ぶさくらんぼ。
dialogues.en: Sakuranbo eats happily, holding her chopsticks uncertainly.
dialogues.text: Sakuranbo eats happily, holding her chopsticks uncertainly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「美味しいよ？」
dialogues.en: "It's good."
dialogues.text: "It's good."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よかったな……俺が作ったんじゃないけど」
dialogues.en: "Good for you... I didn't make it, though."
dialogues.text: "Good for you... I didn't make it, though."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへ」
dialogues.en: "Haha...."
dialogues.text: "Haha...."

dialogues.jp: 見ている者の心があったまる笑顔。
dialogues.en: Her beautiful smile makes me warm.
dialogues.text: Her beautiful smile makes me warm.

dialogues.jp:
変わっていないようで、変わってしまった関係
だが、それはそれで悪くなかった。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure if our relationship has changed or not, but I'm
okay with what we have now.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure if our relationship has changed or not, but I'm
okay with what we have now.

dialogues.jp: まぁ、また始まりからだ。
dialogues.en: Well, it gets to start all over again.
dialogues.text: Well, it gets to start all over again.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「美味しいよ」
dialogues.en: "It's so delicious."
dialogues.text: "It's so delicious."

dialogues.jp:
一口食べるごとに、さくらがわざわざ俺に話し
かけてくる。
dialogues.en: Sakura talks to me in between every bite she takes.
dialogues.text: Sakura talks to me in between every bite she takes.

dialogues.jp:
腹は減っていたが、それが気にならないくらい
なにかが身体の中につまった昼休みだった。
dialogues.en:
I know I was hungry, but somehow today I feel full without
bothering.
dialogues.text:
I know I was hungry, but somehow today I feel full without
bothering.

dialogues.jp: ◆小さなお弁当◆
dialogues.en: ◆Small lunch box◆
dialogues.text: ◆Small lunch box◆

dialogues.jp:
昼休み、転校してきたさくらが張り切って教室
にのりこんでくる。
dialogues.en:
At lunch recess, the transfer student, Sakura, rushed into
the classroom.
dialogues.text:
At lunch recess, the transfer student, Sakura, rushed into
the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
長い別れに比べれば、昼休みなんて短い時間だ
が、お弁当をつつきながらにこやかに笑うさく
らに、なんだか心を癒されてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Lunch recess is too short to compare to the time we've been
apart, but Sakura's smile while she's eating calms my soul.
dialogues.text:
Lunch recess is too short to compare to the time we've been
apart, but Sakura's smile while she's eating calms my soul.
